sources.title: Fibo 2.0: Local VRAM and Hardware Fit
sources.snippet: Fibo 2.0 is the second generation of Bria's FIBO family and the first to unify image generation and image editing in a single model. It supports instruction-based edits, masked edits and multi-reference edits with up to four input images, and preserves unedited parts of the image.
